notes: Official image name is lovecards-web-frankenphp:latest (docker save/load artifact in the lovecards-web-frankenphp.zip release), not a public registry image. install.sh loads it via docker load; compose uses pull_policy: never.

Official Compose maps host 80/443/443-udp. This package exposes a single HTTP port (PANEL_APP_PORT_HTTP -> container 80) so 1Panel reverse proxy can terminate HTTPS; SERVER_NAME stays WEB_SERVER_NAME from the form.

Official .env only defines WEB_SERVER_NAME, MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD, MYSQL_TZ. MYSQL_DATABASE/USER default to lovecards as in official compose. MYSQL_PASSWORD is promoted to a form field (default lovecards) instead of a hardcoded literal for 1Panel secret handling.
mysql:5.7 matches official Compose; architectures limited to amd64 because the official mysql:5.7 image is amd64-only.
Volumes and env keys copied from official .docker/frankenphp/docker-compose.yaml. Both services join 1panel-network and use ${CONTAINER_NAME} naming for 1Panel.
Application runs as the FrankenPHP image default user (root in the official Dockerfile chain). No host init_permissions from official sources; install wizard writes config/public mounts.
